# Developer Toolkit

> > Master AI-powered development with comprehensive tutorials and guides for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex — from setup to production-ready workflows.

Developer Toolkit provides 350+ tutorials, real-world scenarios, and productivity patterns for AI-assisted development. Learn to leverage Claude Code CLI, Cursor IDE, and modern AI coding tools with TypeScript, React, and Node.js through hands-on lessons covering setup, implementation, security, performance optimization, and enterprise workflows.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code CLI workflows
- Cursor IDE automation
- Codex integration
- CLAUDE.md configuration
- AI-assisted development patterns
- Slash commands and context management
- Production-ready code generation
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- TypeScript and React development
- Node.js project automation
- Code review and security auditing
- Performance optimization strategies
- Enterprise coding workflows
- Developer productivity patterns
- CLI-driven development

## Getting Started
